fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced box cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Box photograph cropped from page 3 of Bombyx’s official English catalog. The page identifies the Noah game, art by Xavier Collette, and the same original card-game edition described by the 2012 English rules. Reduced to 327 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The shortest player starts the first round.
clarifications: At the end of a round, the player with the highest penalty score starts the next round.

sources.title: Noah: English rulebook
sources.location: Game Setup; End of Round & Game

internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 3 gives the shortest-player criterion, and page 7 assigns the next round to the player with the highest score. Page 7 bears the Bombyx logo and credits; 55 cards, five ferries and Noah token match inventory BGG 116858. SHA-256: 0fccbb1df06917da242e8c87393b58fce6ce0e96a42adfa1287f75e0d736d013. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The rules specify no tie procedure for equal height or the later highest score.
